descriptions.description: Kirchneriella is a genus of green algae in the family Selenastraceae.See the NCBI webpage on Kirchneriella. Data extracted from the The genus name of Kirchneriella is in honour of Emil Otto Oskar von Kirchner (1851&ndash1925), who was a German botanist and agronomist. The genus was circumscribed by Wilhelm Schmidle in Ber. Naturf. Ges. Freiburg vol.7 on page 82 in 189.
